rules: For directly verifiable event types, SHA-256(payload bytes) must equal the recorded SHA-256 digest.
Missing canonical payload bytes are INDETERMINATE, never PASS.
Mismatch between recomputed and recorded digest is DENY.
Event types outside the directly verifiable set are INDETERMINATE under this profile.
EV_NO_ACTION is a non-extending control and is INDETERMINATE for payload-digest coherence.
Payload-digest coherence does not prove that firmware measured the intended underlying object.
result_bindings: input_sha256 binds the result to the exact canonical event stream
verifier_source_sha256 binds the executing verifier source
content_sha256 is the canonical self-hash of the result
